# SB Properties UK

Property buying and investor introductions for homeowners in Glasgow and Central Scotland.

## Buying model
SB Properties may buy a property directly or discuss an introduction to suitable investors if it is not going to buy. Investor introductions require discussion and permission before contact details are shared. Enquiries do not commit an owner to sell. No offer or completion date is guaranteed at enquiry stage.

## Property focus
Properties needing repairs, inherited or empty homes, tenanted properties and owners considering an alternative after a failed sale. Suitability is assessed individually. Offers may be below open-market value and reflect condition, costs and investment requirements.
